english.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday word for someone or something strongly disliked.
This is the all-purpose choice for something detestable or deeply disliked.
Use this when the irritating thing is especially disliked or objectionable, rather than merely bothersome.
Use this when the person or thing is annoying in an obnoxious or strongly dislikeable way.
Use this for an unpleasant person, behaviour, or thing that you dislike or find annoying.
Use this when the bothersome quality is chiefly irritating or unpleasant, especially for a person or behaviour.

examples.english: I find this arrangement really detestable.
examples.traditional: 我真係好討厭呢個安排。

examples.english: I find it abhorrent when people do not clear their table after eating.
